name: RANSAC plane segmentation for architectural space extraction from TSDF-filtered point cloud
donor: Open3D RANSAC + PROSAC (Schil et al. 2006), PlanarSpaceSegmenter concept

inputs.description: TSDF-fused point cloud (output of exp-TSDF-001) of static hall scene

notes: RANSAC plane-fitting operates on the noise-filtered TSDF point cloud, not raw COLMAP output. It segments walls/floor/ceiling robustly because visitor/temporary points fail the distance-threshold test and are rejected as inliers. Angle and verticality constraints classify planes. This is the recommended replacement for manual point-cloud intersection logic.
